title: The Latest Crier for Feb 04, 2026
items:
Central Black History Month Kickoff | Catered Lunch & Student-led Discussion | Please RSVP

Join us Tuesday, February 3 during common hour in the Maytag BMW rooms. The campus community is invited to attend the Black History Month Kickoff Lunch and Learn, a student-led continuation of the conversation sparked by the MLK Day keynote lecture, Moment of Impact: Race, Injury, and Memory in Iowa College Football, by Dr. Jaime Schultz. Lunch will be catered by Momma Moody’s Catering, a minority-owned business. Space is limited to the first 60 to RSVP here: https://forms.gle/ZNTbABRic6rzGBZU6

Tutoring and Writing Hub

The Tutoring and Writing Hub is open Sunday evenings from 6-8 pm and Monday - Thursday from 2-4 pm and 6-10 pm. There is always a writing tutor available when we are open! 
Subject tutors are also available:

Intercollegiate Honor Band

Publicity statement for the Intercollegiate Honor Band 2/6/25 and 2/7/25. 
Hello, All. 

We are excited to announce that Central College is again hosting the Intercollegiate Honor Band Festival on February 6th and 7th. The students will rehearse throughout the day on Friday, February 6th,t and in the morning on February 7th. The Concert will take place in Douwstra Auditorium at 2:00 PM on Saturday, February 7th. The Conductor for the event is Dr. Scott Jones from Ohio State University. The Concert includes works by Adam Schoenberg, Andrew Boysen Jr., Aaron Perrine, and Karl King. Students from the following schools will be participating: Central College, William Penn University, Coe College, University of Dubuque, Buena Vista University, Simpson College, St. Ambrose University, Iowa Central Community College, Northwestern College, and Clarke University. 

The public is invited and encouraged to attend the concert at 2:00 on Saturday. Please consider joining us for a performance of some fantastic wind band music. 

Brad Lampe 

Stan Dahl

Friday, Feb. 6 is a Late Night Central Karaoke Night in Fred's!

Student Involvement is hosting a Late Night Central THIS Friday, Feb. 6! Swing by Fred's from 7-9pm for hot cocoa and fun Karaoke! All who participate will be entered into a $50 Spirit Shoppe gift card giveway! See you Friday!

LifeServe Blood Drive & Culver's Ice Cream!

Want to save lives & possibly win a pint of Culver's ice cream?! On Tuesday, February 17, 2026 we will be hosting a LifeServe Blood Drive in the BMW Rooms . Time slots are available throughout the day starting at 9:30 am & ending at 2:00 pm . Follow this link to sign up ahead of time to donate blood! Have questions, contact Hannah at laflinh@central.edu. 
https://lifeserve-donor.prod.forcytesp.com/schedule-donation?date=2026-02-17&operation_id=544060&operation_type=drives

First Aid, CPR, and AED Certification

Are you interested in becoming First Aid, CPR, and AED certified or do you need to renew your current or expired certification? If so, please email Dr. Shelli Green (greens@central.edu) by 5pm on Friday, February 6, 2026 to express your interest in taking an American Heart Association Heartsaver course. More details will be provided once you have contacted Dr. Green.

Super Bowl Party!

Join us this Sunday at 5:30 pm in the Upper Chapel to watch the Super Bowl & eat ALL the snacks! Feel free to bring homework, watch football, & enjoy community.
